title: Overnight shipment and local bodega expense scrapbook
content:
Purpose: quick, messy reference for night/weekend shipments, last-mile vendor contacts, and small cash purchases (bodega/coffee/snacks) when running demos or doing overnight booth builds. Intended for on-call folks + delivery volunteers.

Context / when to use:
- Late arrivals (after 6pm) where FedEx/UPS/outbound courier options are closed for pickup.
- Need to buy last-minute power strips, gaffer tape, snacks, or printer paper at local 24/7 shops.
- Shipping label mistakes that require a quick local print + drop.
- When receipts are single-line cash slips or phone screenshots — how to triage for Concur.

Quick contacts (local / 24h friendly):
- RapidPrint Charlotte (24/7 late-night prints) — 704-555-0198 — 2801 N Tryon St, Charlotte, NC 28206 — walk-in labels, laminating, small runs.
- Midtown FedEx Hold (evening drop) — 800-463-3339 ext. 4 — request "hold for pickup" at location 28102.
- NightShift Couriers (local same-night pickup, small packages) — nightshiftcouriers.com / dispatch@nightshiftc.com — 704-555-1122.
- Southside 24 Grocery (useful for snacks/USB-A cables) — 704-555-2233 — keep transactions under $75 for simple reconciling.

Expense capture rules (night-mode):
1) If it's a printed receipt: take photo (top-down), include timestamp screenshot from phone, and upload to Slack #expenses-night immediately.
2) If it's a one-line cash slip (bodega): write a 1-sentence note on the back (attendee name / purpose / event code) and photograph both sides.
3) For courier invoices: get the PDF/invoice emailed to you. If courier only gives a paper slip, scan/photo + include tracking number in the Concur comment.
4) Always tag with cost center: EVENTS-TRAVEL-023 (unless told otherwise).
5) Submit in Concur within 5 business days or note as an "after-hours urgent" expense to speed approval.

Suggested per-diem for volunteers (overnight ops):
- Breakfast (if early morning work): $12
- Dinner (late shifts): $18
- Snacks / incidentals per shift: $10
Notes: keep per-person charging obvious — separate receipts when possible to avoid splitting.

Sample expense entry (copy/paste to Concur comment):
- "Overnight bodega run — power strips + 2x coffee (Night shift build) — volunteer: Lucas Chen — EVENTS-TRAVEL-023 — $43.12 — photo uploaded to #expenses-night & Concur attachment."

Rules for shipping labels / last-minute prints:
- If it's a single exhibit box that needs to be shipped same-day and FedEx is closed: use RapidPrint to print label and NightShift Couriers for pickup. Capture label print proof + courier manifest.
- If you purchase postage at UPS/FedEx store after hours (some locations allow), ask for manifest number and keep receipt.
- For vendor pickup (Venmo/cash) — record vendor name, photo ID shown (if any), and attach GPS screenshot of vendor location to the ticket.

Typical costs to expect (ballpark, per event night):
- Label printing (color, 1 page): $1.25–$3.00
- Overnight courier pickup: $25–$65 (local distances)
- Emergency electronics (multi-pack power strip): $12–$28
- Snacks / drinks: $6–$40 (depends if buying for a crew)

Open questions / TODOs:
- Who is the after-hours approver for emergency spend > $200? (Asked Legal & Finance 2025-02-18, waiting for response; ticket JIRA-3421).
- Should we pre-fund petty cash envelopes at big-city venues (enable floor staff to avoid reimbursement delays)? Pros: faster ops. Cons: reconciliation overhead.
- Add RapidPrint to "approved vendor" list for events? (If approved, procurement code for night prints will be simpler.)

Logistics checklist (for a 10-person overnight build):
- [ ] Reserve RapidPrint account or know account number for printing against company card.
- [ ] Bring pre-printed blank labels (if available) and a Sharpie for quick corrections.
- [ ] Pack 2x power strips, 1x multi-outlet extension, 1x small cable kit.
- [ ] Cash float: $150 (recommended) — store receipts in envelope labeled with date + event.
- [ ] Assign receipt keeper (photo upload + Concur submit within 5 days).

Night shift Slack habits + folder locations:
- Post photos to #expenses-night (channel pinned messages include instructions + Concur link).
- Use folder: /shared_drives/events/night-shift-receipts/CHARLOTTE-2025 for raw photos. (Ops will move to Concur later.)

Receipt triage decision tree (very rough):
- If receipt > $250: escalate to on-call manager and get approval as a comment in Slack.
- If receipt is partial (missing vendor name): add context note + attach GPS screenshot + vendor photo if possible.
- Tip lines: include tips as separate line item in Concur with explanation ("driver tip for same-night pickup").

Post-event cleanup (owner: assigned receipt keeper):
- Consolidate photos and name them: DATE_VENDOR_AMOUNT_USER (e.g., 2025-02-14_RapidPrint_3.50_LChen.jpg).
- Create a single Concur expense report per event night and attach all photos.
- Flag any reimbursements needing expedited approval with the finance alias finance@redwood.ai.

Notes to self (random):
- Remember: some 24/7 groceries have no EIN on receipts — that will block Concur unless we add a note. Keep vendor contact or proof of purchase.
- For international events, keep small local-currency change for taxis — photograph exchange rate on your phone.

References & prior tickets:
- CONF-7892 (overnight-shipping-guidelines) — on Confluence — good general policy but missing local vendor recommendations.
- JIRA-3421 — approval flow question for overnight >$200.
- PR #128 (ops-shipments) — added NightShift courier to README but not vendor list yet.

If you're the volunteer on duty: three rules of thumb:
1) Photograph everything immediately. If you forget, it's not reimbursable.
2) Keep an itemized note for cash runs (time, items, who asked you to buy).
3) When in doubt — ask on #events-oncall; tag finance for approvals > $200.

End of scratchpad. This is intentionally messy — use as quick-reference and update with new vendor numbers as we get them.
